requirement:
The user should be able to search for a product.

When the user enters a valid product search term, matching products should be displayed.

Search should be case-insensitive and support partial matching.

Search should check both product name and product description.

Display 10 products per page when multiple products match.

When the user searches for a product that does not exist, display:
"No products found".

scenarios.title: Search for valid product by exact name
scenarios.description: Verify that searching for an exact product name displays matching products.
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter 'Backpack' into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: Matching products containing 'Backpack' in the name or description are displayed

scenarios.title: Search with case-insensitive query
scenarios.description: Verify that search is case-insensitive for product names and descriptions.
preconditions: A product with the name 'Bike Light' exists
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter 'bIkE LiGhT' into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: Matching products are displayed regardless of the casing used in the query

scenarios.title: Search with partial matching term
scenarios.description: Verify that search supports partial matching against product names and descriptions.
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter 'Jack' into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: Products containing the partial term 'Jack' are displayed

scenarios.title: Search matching product description
scenarios.description: Verify that the search checks product descriptions as well as product names.
preconditions: A product description contains the unique term 'water-resistant'
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter 'water-resistant' into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: The product whose description contains 'water-resistant' is displayed in the results

scenarios.title: Search for non-existent product
scenarios.description: Verify that searching for a non-existent product displays the correct 'No products found' message.
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter 'NonExistentProduct12345' into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: The message 'No products found' is displayed

scenarios.title: Pagination display for multiple matching products
scenarios.description: Verify that pagination displays 10 products per page with pagination controls below the results.
preconditions: More than 10 products match a broad search query
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter a search query that returns more than 10 results
Submit the search
Observe the results area and pagination controls
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly 10 products are displayed on the first page, and pagination controls with Previous and Next buttons and current page number are displayed below

scenarios.title: Navigate through pagination pages
scenarios.description: Verify the user can use pagination controls to navigate to the next page and previous page.
preconditions: A search query matching more than 10 products has been executed
steps: Click the 'Next' pagination button
Observe the displayed products
Click the 'Previous' pagination button
Observe the displayed products
scenarios.expectedResult: Clicking 'Next' displays the next set of matching products and updates the page number, and clicking 'Previous' returns to the prior page

scenarios.title: Submit empty search query
scenarios.description: Verify that submitting an empty search query keeps the complete product list visible in its default order without showing 'No products found'.
preconditions: Products are displayed on the page
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Leave the search input field empty
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: The complete product list remains visible in its existing default order, and 'No products found' is not displayed

scenarios.title: Submit search query with only spaces
scenarios.description: Verify that submitting a search query containing only spaces trims the input, does not perform a search, and keeps the complete product list visible.
preconditions: Products are displayed on the page
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter multiple spaces into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed, no search is performed, the complete product list remains visible, and 'No products found' is not displayed

scenarios.title: Search with special characters and symbols
scenarios.description: Verify that special characters and symbols are treated as normal text without causing errors or executing code.
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter '!@#$%^&*()' into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: Special characters are treated safely as normal text, the application does not error out, and either matching products or 'No products found' is displayed appropriately

scenarios.title: Search with accented characters
scenarios.description: Verify that accented characters are handled safely and matched case-insensitively.
steps: Navigate to the product search feature
Enter 'Café' into the search input field
Submit the search
scenarios.expectedResult: Accented characters are handled safely and matched correctly without application errors
